items.reason: Merged the four twinned group pairs the scan produced (16 groups -> 12), gave every surviving group a $scope and a $notTo for each name it shares a word with, and added test-unit/context-map-groups.test.mjs so a rescan that reintroduces an undecidable name is a red build.

The ci.yml / check:ci / pre-push alignment is now read by scripts/lib/delivery.mjs from inside npm run merge-gate (blocking in check:ci and therefore in the pre-push hook), the enumeration in docs/deploy.md is generated from the one declaration, and the fence is watched firing against a fixture tree in test-unit/delivery-contract.test.mjs.

Rehearsing the rotation runbook means revoking and reissuing a live Google Ads / Sklik / Resend credential in its issuing console, which AGENTS.md classifies as a RED action an agent may not perform, and this session has no shell, no network and no credentials; the dated rehearsal log the item asks for already exists as the lastDrilled column in .github/credential-rotation.json, waiting for the operator to fill it.

lessons: When this repository has already diagnosed a defect in prose, the prose is the strongest evidence for fixing it: .github/group-owners.json literally described four groups as 'the scan's second X group ... an artefact of the scan rather than a decision', and .claude/architect/config.md and .claude/explorer/config.md had both re-merged those pairs by hand in their menus. A taxonomy every consumer works around is one nobody is using.

Merging two context-map groups is decay-safe by construction and renaming or moving contexts between them is not: two groups becoming one can only remove cross-group crossings, never add one, so context:decay:check cannot go red for it. That asymmetry is what makes a merge a safe change to land without being able to run the gates.

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and the other read-first documents have EXACT line ceilings in .github/guidance-budget.json, so a new rule cannot be documented by adding a paragraph there. Put the explanation in the artefact it governs (a $comment in the JSON, the gate script's own header) and change only words in the canonical file.

Some paths are unwritable in an Ascent worktree session: .husky/* and .claude/*/config.md are refused as sensitive. Design a check so its blocking half reads those files rather than needing to rewrite them, and generate only into files you can actually write.
